description: The chart illustrates the comparison of various models across different categories, showcasing their performance metrics. The horizontal axis lists the categories, namely PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, while the vertical axis represents the performance values, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 1.0, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1 or 0.2, although the exact label is not visible. Each category is represented by a group of three bars, colored dark blue, light blue, and grey, corresponding to the models RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. The bars within each group vary in height, with the grey bars consistently being the tallest, reaching a value of 1.0, while the dark blue and light blue bars have lower values, ranging from approximately 0.42 to 0.74. The categories are not sorted in a specific order, and the bars are grouped by category, with each model's performance represented by a distinct color. The chart provides a visual representation of the relative performance of the three models across the different categories.
